messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-quarter check-in: pod rebalancing, QBR deck + dependency asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter status and a small set of asks ahead of next week’s QBR. I attached a working deck (QBR-deck-draft-v2.pptx) and a one-page mutual action plan for SaaSCo. TL;DR: we’re roughly on track for the quarter, but two OKRs need scope adjustments unless we get two platform dependencies settled by 9/15.

OKR snapshot (high level):
- Revenue: +62% toward goal (on plan), risk: 1 large POC (SaaSCo) conversion timing (deal SAAS-7421).
- Platform: reduce 95p latency by 15% (current +8%, behind).
- Cost: per-token cost down 12% (needs additional quantization rollout).
- Developer experience: onboarding time target at 70% (we’re 55%).

Key asks / dependencies (need owners + ETA):
1) Dedicated pool seat for SaaSCo POC (they need isolated capacity for load tests). Owner: Platform. ETA request: 9/10.
2) SOC2 excerpt and data retention confirmation for procurement (Procurement team + Compliance). SaaSCo procurement wants a couple of artifacts before moving to DocuSign. ETA request: 9/12.
3) Short Dedicated latency test run — platform needs to validate 95p SLO on current kernel across 4k seqs. Owner: Monica. ETA: 9/13.
4) Mutual-action-plan alignment and signoff (Aditya/SaaSCo/Legal). DocuSign link will be used.

Risks that will force rescope: if (1) and (3) are not done by the ETAs, we should plan a scaled-down feature set for the POC (remove streaming, use batch-only). I’d rather avoid that but flagging now.

Please reply with owner confirmations in-line + any blockers. I’ll incorporate into the QBR slide and send a final pack on 9/14 EOD.

Attachments: QBR-deck-draft-v2.pptx (pptx, ~3.1MB), mutual_action_plan_SaaSCo.xlsx (xlsx, ~120KB)

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
[Attachment: QBR-deck-draft-v2.pptx]

Subject: Re: Mid-quarter check-in: pod rebalancing, QBR deck + dependency asks

Thanks Aditya — good concise summary. Two quick asks:

- Aditya: confirm the exact concurrency and expected sustained RPS for the SaaSCo POC. I want concrete numbers to prioritize the Dedicated seats vs. burst capacity.
- Monica: if we can’t validate the 95p SLO in a single test window, suggest we create a short-run fallback policy (lower seq or model variant) instead of removing streaming entirely.

I’ll clear with Legal on the DocuSign timeline but sounds like procurement artifacts are straightforward. Please add the HubSpot deal link to the QBR slide (SAAS-7421).

On the owners: I can own the exec ask and escalate if seat provisioning misses the ETA.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Aditya — confirming I’ll run the Dedicated latency validation. Preliminary notes:
- Test plan: 3x 30-minute runs at expected POC concurrency (please provide numbers). We’ll run both quantized and FP16 variants.
- Platform risk: current kernel library shows a regression for 4k sequences on A100 at high concurrency; I’ll instrument the run and produce a short findings doc. If regression holds, proposed fallback is the model-variant route (same model, smaller head) as Vivek suggested.

I can get a seat allocation stub by 9/10 if infra scheduling allows; I’ll ping infra on the slot. I’ll also upload SOC2-excerpt.pdf to the drive folder for procurement to reference.

Aditya/Monica — thanks for the clear ask. A few notes from our side (procurement):
- We can sign a short PoC mutual action plan once we get the SOC2 excerpt and the DocuSign packet. Please upload the SOC2 excerpt to the shared drive; the excerpt is sufficient, we don’t need the full report.
- For seat allocation: expected sustained concurrency for our POC load test is ~45 concurrent sessions, peak RPS ~220. We plan a 2-hour stress run + a 30-minute validation run.
- Legal requests a standard SLA appendix for Dedicated pools (can your legal team share a template?)

Thanks all — quick commitments & owners so I can finalize the QBR pack by 9/14 EOD: 
- Monica: run Dedicated latency validation and upload findings by 9/13. Owner confirmed.
- Platform/Infra: allocate a Dedicated seat stub for the POC by 9/10 (Infra owner: Laura Bennett).
- Compliance/Legal: upload SOC2-excerpt.pdf and a short data-retention blurb by 9/12 (Monica will upload SOC2 excerpt; Legal to confirm blurb).
